def estimate_from_full(full_sample, n_sites_denom=297):
    tm=full_sample.groupby('month_dt')['ped'].sum().reset_index().rename(columns={'ped':'treated_ped'})
    ac=full_sample.groupby('month_dt')['post'].sum().reset_index()
    ac['share']=ac['post']/n_sites_denom
    tm=tm.merge(ac, on='month_dt')
    agg=pd.concat([ tm[['month_dt','treated_ped']].rename(columns={'treated_ped':'ped'}).assign(unit='treated'), city[['month_dt','pedestrian_injury_crashes']].rename(columns={'pedestrian_injury_crashes':'ped'}).assign(unit='city')])
    agg['is_treated_unit']=(agg['unit']=='treated').astype(int)
    agg=agg.merge(ac[['month_dt','share']], on='month_dt', how='left')
    agg['did']=agg['is_treated_unit']*agg['share']
    agg['month_str']=agg['month_dt'].astype(str)
    md=pd.get_dummies(agg['month_str'], drop_first=True, dtype=float)
    X=pd.concat([agg[['did','is_treated_unit']], md], axis=1)
    X['intercept']=1
    y=agg['ped']
    m=sm.GLM(y, X, family=sm.families.Poisson())
    res=m.fit(disp=0)
    return res.params['did'], res.bse['did']
